title: An archived tier's name asks to rename the archived tier first
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, archived, named for example Fleet Old.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Tier.
  3. Type tier A's name.
  4. Click Create Tier.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list shows the active tiers.

Step 2:

  • The new tier's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The typed name shows.

Step 4:

  • The error reads "An archived tier is called Fleet Old. Rename it first."
  • No tier is created.
